License: BSD-3-Clause. LICENSE is shipped in Apple Jack Resources.
The original source is vendored here for reproducible builds. Build script:
Scripts/build.py. Get/stream/send and their dependencies
are compiled; seek, shuffle, repeat, speed and test executables are not.
The app invokes the metadata stream and Back/Play-Pause/Forward transport
commands through the macOS /usr/bin/perl loader. Transport commands use
short-lived processes with bounded timeouts and no automatic retries.
Media buttons no longer synthesize keyboard events or require post-event
Accessibility/Device Control permission.
An Apple Jack parent-exit monitor is compiled alongside the upstream files.
No SIP changes, private entitlement forgery, downloaded binaries, or system
file modifications are used. Metadata stays local. Artwork is read from embedded
system data and downsampled, with no app-side network artwork requests.
This uses Apple's private MediaRemote APIs, which may change in OS updates.
Revisit the backend before App Store distribution or macOS changes.
